name: Superior Semicircular Canal Dehiscence Syndrome (SSCDS)

category.name: Ears, General
category.part: AME Physical Examination Information and Disposition Tables

what_to_bring: The individual never had symptoms*; and
Released to full duties by the treating physician; and

A current, detailed Clinical Progress Note generated from a clinic visit with the treating ENT (otolaryngologist), preferably a neurotologist (a sub-specialty of ENT/otolaryngology). The clinic visit should be no more than 90 days prior to the AME exam. It must include:
A detailed summary of the history of the condition;
Current medications, dosage, and side effects (if any);
If in remission, when did remission commence.
Current clinical audiogram with Air- Conduction/Bone- Conduction (AC/BC) and Speech Discrimination (SD) (performed within the past 90 days).
Additional tests such as (ECOG, VEMP, MRI with Gadolinium of the cerebellopontine angle [CPA], etc.) performed as clinically indicated.
Copy of Operative report (if surgery performed).

rows.label: A
rows.condition: Incidental finding on imaging AND NO symptoms
rows.evaluation_data: The AME should obtain why the imaging was performed. Review a detailed, Clinical Progress Note from ENT (otolaryngology) performed any time after identification on imaging. If the ENT evaluation verifies: - An incidental finding on imaging; - The individual never had symptoms*; and - No required treatment AND The AME verifies no symptoms since diagnosis and there is no other condition found (which warranted imaging): If ANY symptoms, go to Row B. *Symptoms may include vertigo induced by a loud noise, autophonia, chronic imbalance, tinnitus, and hyperacusis. If another condition is found, see that page.
rows.evaluation_data_html:
The AME should obtain why the imaging was performed.

Review a detailed, Clinical Progress Note from ENT (otolaryngology) performed any time after identification on imaging. If the ENT evaluation verifies:

  • An incidental finding on imaging;
  • The individual never had symptoms*; and
  • No required treatment

AND

The AME verifies no symptoms since diagnosis and there is no other condition found (which warranted imaging):

If ANY symptoms, go to Row B.

*Symptoms may include vertigo induced by a loud noise, autophonia, chronic imbalance, tinnitus, and hyperacusis.

If another condition is found, see that page.

rows.label: B
